$about: Everything Quill says, in one place. Edit the text freely. Words in {curly} brackets are filled in by the app (a name, a theme), so keep them, spelled the same. A list is several bubbles shown together, or a set the app picks from (the 'where' says which). Not here: quest step instructions (src/quests/library.ts, tutorial content rather than Quill's personality), help topics, and plain app messages like errors. Review page: brand/dialogue/index.html. Apply an exported changes file with: npm run dialogue:apply <file.json>

text: Here you draw things, then make them move, either Frame-by-frame, or let Tweens do the hard work.
Smooth vector art or chunky pixel art, toons, game sprites, stickers, explainers, or even backgrounds for your phone:
If it wiggles, we can help you make it.
It's easy and it's fun, I promise!
onboarding.hello.where: First-run hello, step 1 (Hello from Quill). Four bubbles beside Quill, one after another.

onboarding.make.cartoons.text: Cartoons! Can't wait to see it uploaded to newgrounds!
onboarding.make.cartoons.where: First-run hello, 'What would you like to make?': you just picked Sketches and cartoons.

onboarding.make.sprites.text: Pixel heroes! Chunky and charming (just like me!)
onboarding.make.sprites.where: First-run hello, 'What would you like to make?': you just picked Game sprites and pixel art.

onboarding.make.tiles.where: First-run hello, 'What would you like to make?': you just picked Tiles and levels.

onboarding.make.motion.text: Smooth moves! Can't wait to see your next infographic!
onboarding.make.motion.where: First-run hello, 'What would you like to make?': you just picked Explainers and motion graphics.

onboarding.make.interactives.text: Interactive art, what will they think of next!
onboarding.make.interactives.where: First-run hello, 'What would you like to make?': you just picked Things for Interactives.

onboarding.make.play.text: A great way to get the creative juices flowing! Just watch out for that blank canvas!
onboarding.make.play.where: First-run hello, 'What would you like to make?': you just picked Just playing.

onboarding.make.none.text: Pick as many as you like, or none at all. No wrong answers here! (Probably)
onboarding.make.none.where: First-run hello, 'What would you like to make?': nothing picked yet.

onboarding.make.some.where: First-run hello, 'What would you like to make?': after un-picking a card, with one to three still picked.

onboarding.make.lots.where: First-run hello, 'What would you like to make?': after un-picking a card, with four or more still picked.

onboarding.make.lead.text: Pick as many as you like and afterwards Quill will set things up to suit.
onboarding.make.lead.where: First-run hello, 'What would you like to make?': the line above the cards (not a bubble).

text: Ahhhh Just look at those little seeds. I could hug this whole screen!
onboarding.themes.loved.where: First-run hello, 'Pick your colours': you picked his favourite (Strawberry). Two bubbles, and a little strawberry pops up beside him.

text: Pink, super comfy on the eyes,  *sigh* I could look at it all day!
But it's your studio. Pick whatever makes you happy, I won't mind. (Much.)
onboarding.themes.hint.where: First-run hello, 'Pick your colours': before you've picked his favourite. Two bubbles.

onboarding.themes.favourite.where: First-run hello, 'Pick your colours': the little heart label under the Strawberry theme cards.

onboarding.prefs.on.text: Just a few handy bits and bobs. You can change any of them later in Preferences.
onboarding.prefs.on.where: First-run hello, 'A few handy settings', with Show Quill on.

onboarding.prefs.off.text: I'll stay hidden, but my words will still pop up here. (...sorry)
onboarding.prefs.off.where: First-run hello, 'A few handy settings', after his goodbye when Show Quill is off.

onboarding.prefs.showQuill.text: Off hides me everywhere. My words still show though.
onboarding.prefs.showQuill.where: First-run hello, 'A few handy settings': the hint beside the Show Quill switch.

text: Something poignant... or roll the dice for some silly ones!
onboarding.name.where: First-run hello, 'Name your first animation'. Two bubbles.

text: Hooray! {name} is going to be brilliant.
Pick how you'd like to start.
I'll be in Help if you need me!
onboarding.done.where: First-run hello, last step ('All set!'). Two bubbles. {name} is the animation's name, or the 'no name' words below.

onboarding.done.noName.where: Stands in for {name} at the start of the 'All set!' bubble when the name box was left empty.

onboarding.done.lead.text: Quill will set up the {workspace} workspace for you shortly. Now, how shall we start {name}?
onboarding.done.lead.where: First-run hello, 'All set!': the line above the three ways to start. {workspace} and {name} show in bold.

onboarding.done.leadNoName.where: Stands in for {name} in the 'All set!' line above the cards when the name box was left empty.

onboarding.done.quest.where: First-run hello, 'All set!': under 'Show me how' ({quest} is the suggested quest).

onboarding.done.example.where: First-run hello, 'All set!': under 'Open an example' ({example} is the suggested example).

onboarding.done.blank.text: Straight in. You know what you're doing.
onboarding.done.blank.where: First-run hello, 'All set!': under 'Just a blank page'.

onboarding.doze.asleep.where: First-run hello: any step left untouched for 20 seconds. Quill nods off.

onboarding.doze.woke.text:
Oh! Sorry, I nodded off. 
But please take all the time you need!
onboarding.doze.woke.where: First-run hello: the first click or key after he nodded off. Shown above that step's own bubbles.

onboarding.skipped.text: No problem! Say hi again any time from Help > Meet Quill again.
onboarding.skipped.where: A toast after 'Skip for now' in the first-run hello.

onboarding.ready.where: A toast after finishing the first-run hello with an example or a blank page.

sillyNames.pattern.where: First-run hello, 'Name your first animation': how a silly name is put together (and what Roll makes).

sillyNames.adjectives.where: Silly names: the first word is picked at random from these. One word each.

sillyNames.nouns.where: Silly names: the second word is picked at random from these. One word each.

sillyNames.fallback.where: Silly names: used only if Roll keeps landing on the same name (very rare). Two different names.

text: I'll be just over here. If you ever need me, say hi from Help > Meet Quill again, or switch me back on in Preferences.
goodbye.long.where: Switching Show Quill off in the first-run hello. Two bubbles while he's sad, then waves goodbye.

goodbye.short.text: Oh... okay, I understand. If you ever need me, I'm in Help > Meet Quill again.
goodbye.short.where: A toast when Show Quill is switched off in Preferences. He's sad for a moment, waves, then goes.

welcomeBack.text: Yay! I knew you'd miss me. (I missed you too.)
welcomeBack.where: Switching Show Quill back on (a toast from Preferences, or a bubble in the first-run hello). He cheers.

quests.panel.intro.text: Short lessons that teach by doing. Pick one and  we'll go through it together!
quests.panel.intro.where: The Quests panel, top, when no quest is going.

quests.panel.allDone.text:
All quests complete! Gosh you're amazing!
Just remember you can always do a quest again to refresh your memory (or even just for fun).
quests.panel.allDone.where: The Quests panel, top, once every quest is done. He cheers.

text: You rizzedmaxxed that skibidi (is that what the kids say?)
quests.praise.where: The quest bar: a little cheer that pops up for a moment when a step is done. Takes turns through these.

quests.badge.where: The badge card at the end of a quest (with confetti): the heading. {badge} is the badge's name.

quests.finished.where: The end-of-quest card heading, for a quest with no badge.

quests.finishedQuest.where: The end-of-quest card, under the heading, for a quest that has no finish line of its own.

welcome.hello.text: Hiya! What are we cooking up today?
welcome.hello.where: The Welcome sheet (Help > Welcome, or on start), beside Quill waving.

welcome.new.where: File > New: the same sheet's heading, beside Quill waving.

welcome.lead.text: Pick any card. You can always change your mind later.
welcome.lead.where: Welcome and File > New sheets, under the heading.

welcome.ready.text: A fresh {kind} is ready. Have fun!
welcome.ready.where: A toast after picking a card on the Welcome or File > New sheet. {kind} is the card's name in lower case.

about.quill.text: This is Quill. His quills are coloured pencils, and he loves to help.
about.quill.where: Help > About Frameling, under the blurb, with Quill waving.

empty.help.text: Uh oh, I couldn't find that
empty.help.where: Help window: a search with no results. Quill thinks.

empty.shortcuts.where: Preferences > Keyboard: a search with no results. Quill thinks.

empty.recent.text: Nothing here yet. Drawings you open or save will show up here.
empty.recent.where: File > Open Recent with nothing in it. Quill doodles.

empty.recover.text:
Nothing to recover. 
but just so you know, work you leave unsaved will show up here for a whole WEEK (just in-case).
empty.recover.where: File > Recover with nothing in it.
